periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonal orientation tilted approximately 45 degrees downward toward the rostrum.

periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Visible tapering and extension towards the lower-posterior boundary of the patch.
